crossRefs.note: At the same time Tattenai, the governor beyond the River came to them, with Shetharbozenai, and their companions, and…
They also asked for the names of the men were who were making this building.

translations.web: Then we asked those elders, and said to them thus, “Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?”
translations.bsb: So we questioned the elders and asked, “Who authorized you to rebuild this temple and restore this structure?”
translations.kjv: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who commanded you to build this house, and to make up these walls?
translations.asv: Then asked we those elders, and said unto them thus, Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?
